## Morning

**8:40 AM pickup for Lecce.** After breakfast, excursion to **Lecce** — often called the Florence of the South. Built in the local cream-colored limestone in the Baroque style, architectural surprises are around every corner: ornate churches, grand piazzas, ancient Roman ruins, and artisan shops selling local olive oil, wine, and ceramics.

At **9:30 AM**, pitstop, then guided tour with **Francesca**.

## Midday

**11:30 AM — Free time** in Lecce.

**12:30 PM — Lunch at Giardino Segreto** (included with local wine).

## Afternoon

**2:30 PM — Return to home base / Masseria dei Monaci.** Afternoon free — pool, relax, refresh.

## Evening

**5:20 PM — Pamela’s shuttle service to the port of Otranto.**

**6:00 PM — Boat tour with Michele & co. + aperitivo. Bring your passport.**

**8:00 PM — Return to the masseria.**
